summary: No Corsica-specific signal on transgender detainees, border screening, document rules, care access or hate violence was identified in the sources. The national assessment for France applies on the island unchanged.
tangentialFactors: The available sources are national in scope: an opinion of the national preventive mechanism on transgender detainees and a press investigation into prison placement. Neither disaggregates its findings to Corsica, and neither names a Corsican prison, court, prefecture or police unit.
localsOnly: No resident-facing finding specific to Corsica appears in the sources. Trans residents on the island fall under the national arrangements set out in the France record.
outOfScopeNotes: Whether the national preventive mechanism has inspected the Corsican prison, and what it found there, is not sourced. The inspections cited in its opinion of 25 May 2021 concern establishments elsewhere in France.
